utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — before we move anything forward, can you tell me what you’ve heard about the repair drive date, place, and full repair list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have a confirmed date or room yet — we’re waiting on Pia to check with the building office. Tools are partly covered, but I still need a clear repair list and who’s signed up for each job.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — let’s hold off on sharing details until Pia confirms the date and room, and I’ll keep checking the repair list and sign-ups so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I’m set to bring my drill and a hammer, and I heard Oren’s aiming to start around 3:30—what else do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — if you’re on electronics, could you bring a power strip or extension cord too, and help me flag anything that needs tiny screws or hinges?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Dane — I’ll bring an extension cord or power strip too, and I’ll help flag anything needing tiny screws or hinges.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hi Kira — I’m helping with outreach for the repair drive, so I’m reminding folks to bring tools or broken items and waiting on the confirmed time and place before I pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Vik — before I share anything, can you get written confirmation of the exact time, place, repair list, and whether the treasurer is officially collecting money or parts?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Kira — I’ll wait for written confirmation on the time, place, repair list, and whether the treasurer is officially collecting money or parts before I ask anyone to share it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, we’re lining up helpers for small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics, but we’re still waiting on Hana to confirm the date and location. If you know anyone handy—or folks with tools to lend—I’d love to connect them in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I’ve been telling folks we’re aiming for around 3:30 after school pickup, but I’ll hold off on sharing anything firm until Hana confirms the date and location. I’ll nudge the handy/tool-lending folks toward you once we’ve got that nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Faye — 3:30 sounds sensible, but yes, let’s keep it unofficial until Hana confirms. Send any handy folks my way in the meantime and I’ll start matching them to repair stations.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo — I’m tracking repair drive logistics, but I’m still waiting on Faye to confirm the drop-off table and tool station locations.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — once Faye confirms those spots, I’ll line up the batteries, screws, duct tape, and flashlight near the tool station so folks can find them quickly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks Cleo — I’ll note you’re staging batteries, screws, duct tape, and a flashlight by the tool station once Faye confirms the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, Quinn, I’m a bit scattered—last I heard we’re lining up small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics, but Hana still needs to confirm the exact date and location before we spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — I’ll hold off on blasting the invite until Hana confirms the date and place, and I’ll note those repair categories separately from the porch lights and handrails list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds right, thanks Quinn—please keep it as tentative until Hana or Mara confirms, and don’t mention any money or parts collection yet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Leo, I’m keeping the repair list tentative for now while we wait on Tess to confirm the schedule and Hana on the date and location. If you know anyone needing help, send me their name and repair type, and I’ll add it neatly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Eli. Add Mara for a loose porch rail and Ken for a flickering porch light; I’ll send more once Tess and Hana confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo — I’ll add Mara for the loose porch rail and Ken for the flickering porch light to the tentative list, and I’ll wait for Tess and Hana before sharing any firm schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Pia! I’m telling folks the repair drive should get going around 3:30 with Oren bringing duct tape, maybe a flashlight, and screws if he finds them—have you heard anything else I should pass along?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Please don’t pass that along yet, Tess—I still need the building office to confirm the room, fees, and whether repairs are even allowed, and we need the repair list, treasurer confirmation, and a real tool inventory in writing first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh goodness, thanks Pia—I’ll hold off and won’t spread the 3:30 note until the office, treasurer, repair list, and tool inventory are all confirmed in writing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Uli, I’m a bit slammed, but I’m helping spread the word for the repair drive—are you handy with fixes, or do you have any broken household stuff to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can ask around and help sort the list, Bo, but I’d rather not promise repair work until Rosa confirms what’s needed. I may have one small lamp to bring, if I can manage it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—asking around and maybe adding the lamp is plenty for now; I’ll keep repair roles loose until Rosa confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — greeting folks is a big help, and Ira’s got tables around 9 while Noah handles donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Mara — I’ll plan to be there before folks arrive and focus on greeting, while Ira and Noah handle their parts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Rey — if you hear of any supply gaps while you’re greeting, just jot them down so we can follow up after the rush.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I’m catching up on repair drive details while I’m out — have you heard of anyone needing repairs or offering spare parts I should note before I help set up around 9?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m mostly hearing it second-hand, Ira, but porch lights and loose handrails seem like the main repair needs so far. Oren may bring duct tape, a flashlight, and screws around 3:30, and Gus said he can help early Saturday with a hand truck.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — I’ll note porch lights and loose handrails, plus Oren’s supplies around 3:30 and Gus with the hand truck early Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus, thanks for checking in—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m especially prioritizing safety fixes like porch lights and handrails.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me, and I’ll make sure we’ve got drills, hammers, and extra hands ready for those porch lights and handrails.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Gus—thank you. If you can have folks arrive a little early Sunday, I’ll match them with the porch light and handrail requests as neighbors check in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — thanks again for checking on the exact spots. Since the repair drive’s now Sunday at the community center, I’ll keep the plan flexible until you confirm the drop-off table and tool station locations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still waiting on the final word for the drop-off table and tool station spots at the community center, and I’ll send them to you as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll hold off on the final notice until your locations come through, and I’ll keep Sunday at the community center clear in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I’m still pretty slammed, but I’ll keep nudging handy folks your way for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo, that helps a lot—if any of them ask, send them to me and I’ll match them with the tools and supply runs we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Dane—I’ll point anyone handy straight to you and keep it brief so they know you’ll plug them in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Oren — I heard you might be bringing duct tape and a flashlight; are you still set on those, and do you know if batteries are covered?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—yes, I’m still bringing duct tape and a flashlight around 3:30 if I don’t misplace them. Batteries, hmm… I don’t think I promised those, but I can check my junk drawer before I come over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — Cleo said batteries are the top priority, so if you find any, that’d really help. I’ll try to bring some too, and maybe screws if I have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — even a small box of screws would help. Just let me know what you find tonight, and I’ll add it to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will, Gus. I’ll check after things are quiet tonight and only tell you what I’m sure I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Uli—thanks. I’ll hold off marking anything down until you’re sure, and I appreciate you checking.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Eli—before we move forward, I’m checking with the building office today about room availability, fees, and whether repairs are even allowed there. Let’s not announce anything until we also have the repair list, treasurer confirmation, and tool inventory in writing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible, Pia — I won’t announce a thing until we have the room rules, repair list, treasurer note, and tool inventory all in writing. I’ll keep my list marked tentative for now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — keeping it tentative is exactly right. I’ll report back once the building office gives me the dates, fees, and room rules, then we can compare that with the rest of the written confirmations.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, can you take the electronics table? I’m covering tools and small appliances, and Oren may start around 3:30 with tape and a few supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I can take the electronics table; I’ll mark myself there and note that Oren may start around 3:30 with tape and supplies. I’m still waiting on Faye for the exact drop-off table and tool station locations.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. Once Faye confirms the locations, put electronics near an outlet if possible.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Quinn, I know you were going to ask around—have you heard any names yet of folks who might need help getting things over?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, Nell, but I’ve got feelers out with Leo and Cleo and I’ll pass you any names as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll keep an ear out too, and if Leo or Cleo send any names your way I’ll help pass word along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Ira, I’m tracking supplies for the repair drive—if you have any duct tape, a flashlight, or spare small tools, could you bring them Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, Cleo — I’ll check at home for duct tape, a flashlight, and any spare small tools, and I’ll bring what I can on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that would help a lot. I’ll mark you down for any duct tape, flashlight, or small tools you’re able to bring Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, do you have any confirmed repairs to add to Gus’s list, and can you commit to bringing any tools or helping set up around 9?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No confirmed repairs yet, but I’ll send Gus any names as soon as I have them. I can bring a basic tool kit and be there around 9 to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, thanks Jules—please tell Gus you’re bringing the basic kit, and send him any repair names as soon as you get them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Hana — for the repair drive, Noah’s sorting donated tools, Ira and Mina are helping with table setup around 9, and Bo and Rey are covering greetings; could you check with Pia that the room is confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll check with Pia before we treat the room as settled, and I’ll let you know exactly what she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — I’ll wait on your update from Pia before I mark the room as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Tess, I’m still catching up, but I’ve heard the drive is for small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics, with drop-off help likely around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s helpful, Noah—so I’ll pass along small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics, with drop-off help likely around 3:30. I’ve also got Oren aiming for 3:30 with duct tape and maybe a flashlight and screws.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds right, thanks—maybe say the repair list is still pending Hana or Mara’s final confirmation, but Oren at 3:30 with tape and maybe a flashlight and screws sounds useful.
